subject: Domtar
title: The mill already had AI sensors when a motor failed; the recovery used support it already paid for
freshness: September 2026 reporting; exact deployment or incident date may precede publication.

McLaughlin estimated 1,546.65 hours of avoided unplanned downtime.
factual_limits: Do not say a model error caused the motor failure or that the sensor system completely failed.

proposed_judgment: Buying detection capacity did not establish a working response loop. The decisive change was putting existing analyst support and follow-through into regular use.
dedup: No Domtar match. Adjacent to fix-the-process-first, but retain only the new concrete mechanism: an existing unused service entitlement, recurring diagnostic feedback, and aged action tracking. Do not repeat the generic process-first lesson. Different from Rockwell's experiential-knowledge retrieval.
visual_feasibility: A warning/detection versus completed repair relationship. The joke targets treating an alert as completed maintenance, not the workers or motor failure.

factual_limits: Supplier/customer-reported comparison, not an independent experiment; budget, absolute saving, baseline and detailed cost calculation undisclosed.
